newsitem.title: LATVIA: NEW LEASING AND FINANCE COMPANY ESTABLISHED.
newsitem.headline: NEW LEASING AND FINANCE COMPANY ESTABLISHED.

text.p: The Investment Bank of Latvia said on Thursday that it had set up a new leasing and financial company, Latvian Industrial Leasing Ltd, with Estonian Industrial Leasing Ltd.
The Investment Bank said in a statement that the foundation documents were signed on Tuesday and that the new company's initial share capital stood at 340,000 lats.
"The main activity (will be) the provision of leasing services for corporate clients," the statement said, adding that the sector focus would be on industrial equipment and heavy trucks.
It said that the new leasing firm would begin its operations after it is registered with the Republic of Latvia's enterprise register.
The Investment Bank of Latvia's main activity is the channeling of loans to small and medium-sized enterprises.
The shareholders of Estonian Industrial Leasing Ltd are Merita Finance, the Estonian Investment Bank, and the International Financial Corporation, the statement said.
